sourceMethod: Independent rendered retrieval of the direct official Qavanin text and metadata pages on 2026-11-21. The pages exposed line-addressable content. Raw HTTP response bytes were not captured, no SHA-256 was computed, and no text-bound human legal review was performed.

amendment1400.title: قانون اصلاح قانون صدور چک

observedProvisions.article1: Removes the quoted cheque-validity-period phrases and the three-year maximum period from Article 6 of the Cheque Issuance Act.
observedProvisions.article2: Changes the transitional rule for Article 21 bis by linking the Sayad registration regime to cheque leaves from cheque books supplied after the end of Esfand 1399, while retaining a prior-rule treatment for older cheque books.
observedProvisions.article3: Adds Article 24 governing guaranteed cheques, including issuance through Sayad, payment to the named beneficiary, cancellation/payment timing, lost-cheque replacement, and consequences for forgery or use of a forged guaranteed cheque.

amendment1400.note: The official portal currently renders the amendment text and its metadata. The displayed Gazette number/date and effective date are portal-observed metadata, not a retrieved Gazette issue file. The 1403/03/30 label belongs to the current consolidated status and does not by itself establish the event-date effect of every intervening amendment.

amendment1358.title: لايحه قانوني اصلاح ماده 17 قانون صدور چك

observedProvisions.main: Replaces the guarantee deposit/bank guarantee mentioned in Article 17 with security, including cash, movable or immovable property, or a bank guarantee.
observedProvisions.proviso1: The legal force of this single-article act lasts only through the end of solar year 1358.
observedProvisions.proviso2: It applies only to cheques issued through 1358/04/31.

amendment1358.note: Official Qavanin text and attribute pages rendered in this recheck. The text itself contains a narrow temporary and cheque-issuance-date transition. Portal-rendered metadata is not a downloaded Gazette issue or raw signed instrument; do not generalize this rule to later cheques without the complete amendment chain and human review.

limitations: Raw HTTP response bytes and a reproducible SHA-256 were not captured.
The official Gazette issue 22188 itself was not downloaded and independently hashed.

The complete amendment chain for the Cheque Issuance Act, including the 1358, 1372, 1376, 1377, 1382, 1397, 1400 and 1403 instruments, has not been independently established for event-date application.
The current consolidated status label is not a substitute for an amendment-by-amendment temporal analysis.
No qualified human legal review bound to the exact source bytes has been recorded.
The official status index lists ten influencing instruments, but its displayed approval dates do not establish each instrument's Gazette publication date or effective date.
The 1358 act text and metadata were rendered, but raw HTTP bytes, SHA-256 and Gazette issue 10043 bytes were not captured.
The 1358 temporary-validity and cheque-issuance-date transition requires exact event-date analysis and independent human legal review.
nextActions: Capture reproducible raw official text and metadata response bytes, record retrieval timestamps and SHA-256 values.
Retrieve and hash official Gazette issue 22188 and the original signed amendment.
Complete the amendment chain and transitional-rule analysis before producing non-overlapping eventDateVersions.
Obtain independent legal review bound to the exact text SHA-256 and record the reviewer's identity, date and decision.
Retrieve and hash official Gazette issue 10043 and the signed 1358 act; bind a human review to the exact source bytes.
Resolve the remaining 1372, 1376, 1377 and 1382 instruments from official text and Gazette metadata before creating event-date versions.
